notes: Style v1, locked 2026-10-06. Never edit 'style' mid-project: bump the version and regenerate, or accept the seam.
style: Flat vector illustration built from simple geometric shapes with crisp edges. Depth comes only from flat overlapping shapes: no gradients, no shading, no soft 3D, no drop shadows, no texture, no outlines. Bold, simple silhouettes. Faces are minimal: small dark dot eyes, short eyebrows, a simple mouth that shows the emotion. Palette: coral #F2545B, amber #F7B32B, teal #1B998B, sky #3E92CC, indigo #2E3192, ink #1A1A2E and cool white #F5F7FA; light areas use cool white, never cream or beige. Soft key light from upper left. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no user-interface details, no border.

cast.notes: Approve this sheet before any scene; it is Image 1 (identity) of every shot.
cast.prompt: Character reference sheet of two people standing side by side, full body, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced, nothing overlapping, even light: (1) Lena, a woman in her early thirties, warm brown skin, short dark hair in a bob, amber sweater, indigo trousers, coral sneakers, calm smile; (2) Omar, a man in his late twenties, light olive skin, curly black hair and a short beard, teal shirt with rolled sleeves, ink-coloured trousers, sky-blue sneakers, friendly expression.

set-office.notes: Empty background plate for a slow push-in: generated 20% larger than the 16:9 preset.
set-office.prompt: An empty small home office seen straight on at eye level: a plain desk against a wall, a window on the left letting in daylight, a potted plant, a shelf with blank book spines. No people. Wide framing with generous space around the desk.

shot-problem.prompt: Lena sitting at the desk from Image 2, seen from the front, rubbing her forehead with one hand, frowning at a laptop whose screen is a plain light rectangle with nothing on it. A tall stack of paper sheets leans next to the laptop. Lena: woman in her early thirties, warm brown skin, short dark hair in a bob, amber sweater, indigo trousers.

references.role: identity and outfits for Lena; match face, hair, clothes and colours exactly
room layout and light only; ignore its framing

shot-problem-relief.notes: One-change iteration: the previous output is Image 1, the cast sheet keeps identity locked.
shot-problem-relief.prompt: Change only Lena's expression: eyebrows raised, a small relieved smile. Keep exactly her pose, hands, clothes, the desk, the laptop, the papers, the framing and the colours.

shot-problem-tidy.notes: Masked edit: white in the mask = region to change. The mask applies to Image 1 (edit_of). Run with --composite-back for a pixel-exact paste.
shot-problem-tidy.prompt: Replace the leaning stack of papers with one neat closed folder lying flat on the desk. Change nothing else.

omar-cheer.notes: Native alpha cutout: needs a gpt-image-2.5 model; png/webp only; checked for real transparency after decode.
omar-cheer.prompt: Omar jumping with joy, both arms raised, mouth wide open in a happy cheer, full body, slightly off the ground, centred with 10% empty margin on every side, nothing cropped. Only Omar. Omar: man in his late twenties, light olive skin, curly black hair, short beard, teal shirt, ink-coloured trousers, sky-blue sneakers.

prop-mug.notes: White subject: generate on mid-grey so the matte keeps the mug, then run cutout.py.
prop-mug.prompt: A plain white ceramic coffee mug seen from a slight three-quarter angle, handle on the right, filling about 70 percent of the frame with even margin. The mug has nothing printed on it.

share-card.notes: Share image art: real title text is composited in code later, so the left 45% stays empty.
share-card.prompt: Lena and Omar standing on the right side of the frame, smiling and looking toward the empty left side, as if presenting it. The left 45% of the image is a calm empty area of flat sky colour for a headline added later.

references.role: identity and outfits for both characters
